name: Tharil'zun's Head
summary: In Lakeshire, Tharil'zun's Head proves the commander who terrorized Redridge is dead. He led the Blackrock Outrunners occupying Stonewatch.

sections.title: Trophy of Stonewatch
sections.body:
Blackrock orcs at Stonewatch Keep have raided Lakeshire's farms and ambushed travelers on the roads. Tharil'zun led the Blackrock Outrunners behind those attacks.

Marshal Marris will not risk acting on rumors or partial victories. He demands proof of Tharil'zun's death, and the severed head gives it. The Outrunners' coordinated ambushes from the keep have suffered a major blow.

faq.answer: Tharil'zun was a crafty and vicious Blackrock orc commander at Stonewatch Keep. He led the Blackrock Outrunners in relentless ambushes with the Renegades between Lakeshire and the keep.

faq.q: Why does Marshal Marris want his head?
faq.answer: Stormwind withholds major military aid from Redridge, so Marshal Marris and the Lakeshire guard rely on mercenaries to strike key threats. Marris needs proof of Tharil'zun's death to know the Outrunners' leadership is truly shattered.
Tharil'zun holds Stonewatch Keep in the eastern hills of Redridge Mountains. Blackrock orcs and gnolls surround the keep.

faq.q: Does taking Tharil'zun's head end the Blackrock threat?
faq.answer: No. Tharil'zun's death disrupts the Outrunners' ambushes, but the Blackrock clan keeps a massive entrenched force in Stonewatch Keep and across the Redridge Mountains.

angles.text: Each Blackrock chieftain slain eases the pressure on Lakeshire, a beleaguered town fighting to survive without official reinforcements from Stormwind.
